headline: Argentina Relaunches ARS 2 Trillion Mortgage Credit Stimulus Scheme
summary: Argentina's Economy Minister Luis Caputo modified and relaunched a 2 trillion peso mortgage credit facility funded by the ANSeS pension guarantee fund to stimulate domestic home lending.
why: Reviving long-term private mortgage credit is a central component of the Milei administration's program to restart domestic construction and banking intermediation.

impacts.name: Argentina Banking
impacts.why: Injecting 2 trillion pesos into mortgage financing increases bank liquidity and loan origination.
